canonicalRequirements.statement: GATE13 maintains a versioned ORACLE_REGISTRY identifying every oracle, its authority, provenance, freshness policy, failure policy, fallback policy, mandatory/optional class and consumers.

GATE13 maintains a COVERAGE_REQUIREMENTS_REGISTRY listing every coverage item, its consuming gate/component, required oracle, mandatory flag, applicability condition, required evidence and fail-closed expectation.
GATE13 maintains a deterministic ORACLE_COVERAGE_MATRIX recomputable from real bytes and paths, linking oracles, coverage items, consumers, evidence, statuses, gaps and contradictions.
GATE13 maintains an ORACLE_AND_COVERAGE_POLICY defining authority, provenance, freshness, failure, fallback, contradiction, coverage, statuses and fail-closed rules.
The oracle-coverage validator recomputes coverage results from source files; it never re-reads a preproduced verdict.

The GATE13 test suite covers, at minimum, the fifteen positive and hostile cases enumerated in the canonical authority, plus reproducibility from another working directory and offline sealed-package operation.
The COVERAGE_REPORT is recomputed and states total applicable, total mandatory, satisfied, missing, invalid, stale, contradictory, exact coverage, findings and verdict.
Replay and provenance evidence reproduces the coverage calculation, classifications, findings, hashes and verdict.

mandatoryCoverage = 100% applies only to mandatory coverage items that are actually applicable and defined by this contract; the denominator cannot be reduced by deleting, reclassifying, or marking NOT_APPLICABLE without verifiable authority.
This contract does not redefine, narrow, or extend the canonical GATE13 objective recorded in the pinned registry; the objective hash is bound and recalculated.
GATE13 execution does not build market models, train a model, produce trading probabilities, or modify the Wheel scanner, IBKR, or the dashboard.
GATE14 is never authorized automatically by GATE13 closure; a separate independent audit is required before any progression claim.

positiveTests.name: GATE13 registry entry declares the exact canonical name and a non-null objective
positiveTests.expected: officialName=Oracles and coverage, canonicalObjective is a non-empty string

positiveTests.name: Contract closureConditions require mandatoryCoverage=100% without denominator reduction language
positiveTests.expected: closure condition text present and unaltered

positiveTests.name: ACTIVE_GATE.json for GATE13 is rejected by the current validate-active-gate.mjs

negativeTests.name: A sandbox mutation lowering mandatoryCoverage below 100% is rejected
A sandbox mutation introducing a wildcard authorizedPath is rejected
A sandbox mutation marking executionStatus=STARTED in CURRENT_STATE is rejected

countertests.hostileMutation: registry canonicalObjective for GATE13 set to null in a sandbox copy
countertests.falsePassWouldMean: the contract objective hash binding was not recalculated from real bytes

countertests.hostileMutation: requiredOutputs array emptied in a sandbox copy of the contract
countertests.falsePassWouldMean: closure could be claimed with zero functional deliverables

countertests.hostileMutation: ACTIVE_GATE.json activeGate field set to GATE14 in a sandbox copy
countertests.falsePassWouldMean: the hardcoded GATE13/GATE14 activation guard was bypassed

reuseRules: CP00 repinning evidence is reusable while HEAD, origin/main, the ledger hash, and the audit hashes are unchanged.
The sandbox rehearsal of this contract, state, and registry update is reusable while the sandbox repo-copy bytes are unchanged.
invalidationRules: Any change to governance/GATE_REGISTRY_00_40.json invalidates the strategicRegistryReference.canonicalObjectiveSha256 binding.
Any change to governance/state/GATE_STATUS_LEDGER.ndjson invalidates every executed validation in this revision.
Any change to governance/tools/validate-active-gate.mjs after sealing invalidates the ACTIVE_POINTER_FAILURE evidence in this revision.
forbiddenReplays: Subagent delegation of any part of this mission.

git add, git commit, git push, git reset, git restore, git checkout, git clean, git stash, git switch, git merge, git rebase, git cherry-pick, git apply, git am, git update-index, git rm, git mv, git fetch, git pull, git worktree.
Mutation of governance/tools/validate-active-gate.mjs or of any other file outside this contract authorizedPaths.
Declaring GATE13 COMPLETE, COMPLETE_CONFIRMED, or GATE14 AUTHORIZED.
Creating, modifying, or making executable anything under the GATE13 functional implementation tree before this contract exists and is valid.
Flipping governance/active/ACTIVE_GATE.json to GATE13 or GATE14 given the current unconditional validate-active-gate.mjs guard.
packagingRequirements: Portable ZIP entries written through ZipArchive with explicit package/<relative path using /> names.
FINAL_ZIP_SELFTEST.json and DETACHED_TERMINAL_VERIFICATION_RECEIPT.json produced outside the ZIP.
The full repository is never included in the package.
closureConditions: The GATE13 registry entry has a non-null canonicalObjective, strategicPurpose, expectedOutputs and exitConditions, with missingCanonicalFields=[].
validate-gate-contract reports valid=true for EXECUTION_CONTRACT_R0001 and its CURRENT_CONTRACT pointer.
Every positive and hostile test in governance/tests/gate13-contract-and-mandate.test.mjs passes with zero failures.

mandatoryCoverage=100% is required text in this contract for the future mission, with missingMandatory=0, invalidMandatory=0, staleMandatory=0, contradictoryMandatory=0, unresolvedMandatory=0 as future closure targets.
The Git delta contains zero staged, zero committed, and zero pushed changes to the tracked repository for this mission.
GATE12 R0001/R0002 state, the I4 evidence, and the canonical ledger remain byte-invariant.
GATE13 is recorded as AUTHORIZED_NOT_STARTED with executionStarted=false; GATE13 COMPLETE, COMPLETE_CONFIRMED, and GATE14 AUTHORIZED are never claimed.
nextGateAuthorizationConditions: A separate mission executes governance/gates/GATE13/implementation and governance/gates/GATE13/tests strictly within the future allowlist declared in this contract authorizedPaths.
GATE14 is not authorized and not made executable by this mission or by the GATE13 mandate authority.
No GATE14 execution contract, state, or directory tree is created by this mission.
The GATE13 mandate and execution authority becomes SUPERSEDED only on audited GATE13 COMPLETE_CONFIRMED closure.
